fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-01 at roughly 09:40, it was reported that the proprietor of Ezhil Cycle Mart noticed missing stock (cosmetic products) valued at Rs. 25,000 near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore. The complainant, Sanjay Raj, provided the contact number 9000000083. The complainant is associated with the business Ezhil Cycle Mart. A person named Logesh Subramani, associated with the number 9000000233, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complaint refers to Siva Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000256. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00284, as the mobile number 9000000233 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Goods reportedly taken in a bag during peak hours.
